styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Stinky tofu, spicy Hunan plates and late-night snack streets.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Yuelu Academy, old streets and Mao's early haunts.

styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, river views and lively evening streets.

stays.why: Downtown core. Walk to snack streets, malls and the metro; easy rides to the river and old town.
Riverside calm near Orange Isle. Good for evening walks and river views; a short metro hop to downtown.
Base for Yuelu Mountain, the academy and university streets. Quieter, greener, west of the river.
Best for early high-speed trains. Plain but practical; metro links you downtown in a few stops.

food: Try Hunan staples: stinky tofu (choudoufu), spicy chopped-pepper dishes and rice noodles for breakfast.
Pozi Street and Taiping Old Street are the classic snack walks; go hungry and share small plates.
Order 'wei la' (mild) if you can't handle heat. Hunan food is genuinely spicy.
Late-night food streets stay busy past midnight; this is a city that eats late.
Prices are low: street snacks often ¥5–20, a sit-down meal roughly ¥40–100 per person.
more_time: Add a half-day on Yuelu Mountain and at Yuelu Academy if you only did downtown.
Take a short high-speed train to a nearby town for a change of scene; check times on the day.
Spend an evening on a river cruise or just walking the Xiang River banks at sunset.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the snack streets, Yuelu Academy and the museums without rushing; add a night for the mountain and river.

month_notes: January: cold and damp, highs near 10°C. Pack a warm coat.
February: still chilly, around 13°C, and one of the wetter months.
March: mild at 18°C but frequent rain; bring an umbrella.
April: pleasant 23°C, rainy spells; good for walking.
May: warm and humid, 27°C, with plenty of rain days.
June: hot and wet, around 30°C; expect sticky afternoons.
July: peak heat near 33°C; plan indoor breaks midday.
August: as hot as July, around 33°C; stay hydrated.
September: hot but drier, 30°C; a good shoulder month.
October: the best month, mild 23°C and fewer rain days.
November: cool and mostly dry, around 18°C; bring a layer.
December: cold at 12°C and drier; warm clothes needed.

climate_guide.summary: Humid subtropical: hot, wet summers and cool, damp winters. Spring and autumn are the most comfortable.

items.title: Hot summers
items.text: July and August peak near 33°C with high humidity. Take midday breaks indoors.

items.title: Rainy spring
items.text: March to June has the most rain days, up to 18 a month. Carry an umbrella.

items.title: Best time: October
items.text: Mild around 23°C with fewer rain days. Ideal for the mountain and river walks.

items.title: Cool winters
items.text: January highs near 10°C and lows near 3°C. Damp cold; pack warm layers.

items.title: Humidity year-round
items.text: Summers feel hotter than the numbers; winters feel colder. Dress in layers.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Light breathable clothes and rain gear for summer; a warm coat and umbrella for winter and spring.

transit.best: Metro for most trips; DiDi for late nights and airport runs.

modes.text: 5 lines plus a maglev link to the airport. Fares are low, roughly ¥2–8. Easiest way around for visitors.
Buses cost ¥1–2; air-conditioned and cross-city routes cost ¥2. Cheap but slower.
Taxis start at ¥8 by day and ¥10 at night, meters standard. DiDi works well; have the destination in Chinese.
Driving is busy and parking is hard. The metro is easier for visitors.
Fine downtown; shared bikes suit short riverside hops.
